# Flight 79

> Flight 79 is an aviation-themed cafe and restaurant at Ruko Sasakirana 79, Kota Baru Parahyangan, serving coffee, pastries, Indonesian dishes, pasta, pizza, steak, oriental bowls, desserts, and refreshers for daily dining, meetings, family gatherings, and private celebrations.

## Overview

- Brand promise: First-class flavor on every plate.
- Location: Ruko Sasakirana 79, Kota Baru Parahyangan, Indonesia
- Opening hours: Monday to Sunday, 08:00 to 21:00 WIB
- Parking: Free parking
- Reservations: Via WhatsApp at +62 851-2130-6972 or through the reservation form on https://coffee.flight79.com/#reserve
- Online delivery: Currently available exclusively on GoFood (https://gofood.link/a/SStfYD7)

## Contact & Official Links

- [Flight 79 Website](https://coffee.flight79.com): Main landing page with menu, gallery, events, online ordering, and table reservation form.
- [Reserve via WhatsApp](https://wa.me/6285121306972?text=Halo%20Flight%2079%2C%20saya%20ingin%20reservasi%20meja.): Direct WhatsApp link to book a table (+62 851-2130-6972).
- [Order Online on GoFood](https://gofood.link/a/SStfYD7): Official GoFood page for online delivery orders (currently available exclusively on GoFood).
- [Google Maps Directions](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jz6UKrGxTk31CAoE7): Route and location pin for Ruko Sasakirana 79, Kota Baru Parahyangan.
- [Full Menu PDF](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1n2gVQrpwr0Q3eWKB6p2HI_khHOABcnaI/view?usp=drive_link): Complete Flight 79 food and beverage menu.
- [Instagram (@flightseventyniner)](https://www.instagram.com/flightseventyniner/): Official Instagram account.

## Menu Overview

For the latest pricing and availability, see the official Full Menu PDF or GoFood page.

### Breakfast & Pastry

- Flight Deck Breakfast: Pre-Flight Omelete, English Breakfast 79er - Bread, English Breakfast 79er Potato, The Cabin Crew's Croissant, The Aviator's Tuna, The Captain's Smoked Beef
- Pastry: Butter Croissant, Almond Croissant, Choco Croissant, Cheese Croissant, Cookies Croissant, Kouign Amann, Cream Cheese Danish, Pain Aux Raisin, Cinnamon Roll, Pistachio Choco Roll

### Soup, Salad & Lite Bites

- Soup & Salad: Chicken Cream Soup, French Onion Soup, Pumpkin Soup, Signature Salad 79, Caesar Salad, Fruits Salad
- Lite Bites: French Fries, Cajun Potato, Onion Ring, Calamari, Mix Platter, Mix Fries, Tortillas Corn, Cireng, Tahu Lada Garam, Pisang Goreng, Pisang Mozza, Spicy Wing, Mozzarella Wing

### Indonesian Delight

- Nasi Bakar Teri Ayam, Nasi Bakar Oncom Ayam, Nasi Ayam Bakar Komplit, Nasi Campur Bali, Ayam Betutu, Sop Iga Garang Asam, Sop Buntut, Buntut Goreng, Nasi Rawon, Nasi Gulai Kambing, Tongseng Kambing, Cruising Iga Bakar Konro, Nasi Goreng 79, Nasi Goreng Daun Jeruk, Nasi Goreng Buntut, Nasi Goreng Pete Ikan Asin

### Pizza, Pasta & Steak

- Pizza: Meat Lovers, Beef Pepperoni, Chicken Lovers, Double Cheesy, Hot Tuna
- Pasta & Noodles: Spaghetti Aglio Tuna, Spaghetti Carbonara, Spaghetti Bolognese, Spaghetti A la Thai, Fried Noodles, Mie Jawa
- Steak: Tenderloin, Sirloin, Meltique Wagyu, T-Bone, Chicken Steak, Salmon (served with potato wedges, French fries, or mashed potato, and mushroom, blackpepper, or BBQ gravy)

### Oriental Menu

- Hainan Chicken Rice 79er, Chicken Katsu 79er, Korean Beef Rice Bowl 79er, Beef Teriyaki Rice Bowl 79er, Spicy Dory Rice Bowl 79er

### Coffee Selection

- Espresso, Americano, Long Black, Cappuccino, Café Latte, Magic Hot, V60 (Fullwash/Honey/Natural), Dirty Lotus Latte, Sweet Cinnamon Coffee, Pistachio Latte (Signature), Caramel Latte, Hazelnut Latte, Vanilla Latte, Iced Coffee 79 (Signature)

### Beverages & Smoothies

- Ice Blended Series: Berry Take-Off (Signature), Chocolate Blend (Signature), Classic Ice Chocolate, Matcha Blend, Classic Ice Matcha (Signature), Mango Horizon, Lychee Breeze (Signature)
- Hot Series: Hot Chocolate (Signature), Hot Matcha
- Mojito & Refreshers: Kiwi Mojito, Mango Mojito (Signature), Lychee Mojito, Strawberry Mojito, Blueberry Mojito
- Artisan Tea: Morning Glory, Ruby Tea (Signature), Mango Mint, Sencha Mint, Iced Tea (Signature), Mineral Water
- Smoothies: Strawberry Smoothies, Dragonfruit Smoothies (Signature)

### Dessert

- Panna Cotta, Creme Brulee, Choco Lava, Affogato, Matchagato, Ice Cream

## Events & Gatherings

Flight 79 hosts private and group occasions, coordinated via WhatsApp (+62 851-2130-6972):

- Birthday celebrations
- Family gatherings
- Corporate meetings
- Community gatherings
- Aviation enthusiast meetups

## Agent Interaction Notes

- Table reservations are completed via WhatsApp. On https://coffee.flight79.com/#reserve, the declarative WebMCP tool `reserve_table` collects guest name, WhatsApp number, date, time (between 08:00 and 21:00), guest count (1 to 30), and optional special requests, then prepares a pre-filled WhatsApp message for user confirmation.
